## Why
Linked implementation: #6023, merged as PR #6042 (`b5f6126b6a4137ed587cad53492525bd2ab26835`; `src/trend_analysis/config/model.py`, `src/trend_analysis/config/models.py`, and `tests/test_config_turnover_validation.py`).

PR #6042 records only that the test would fail "by test design," not an executed break/revert result.

## Scope
Verify the finite-value guard by temporarily removing it, observing the targeted test fail, restoring the guard, and recording the passing result.

## Non-Goals
No production behavior change is requested.

## Tasks
- [ ] Remove the finite guard in a temporary working tree, run `pytest tests/test_config_turnover_validation.py::test_lambda_tc_rejects_non_finite`, capture the failing result, then restore the guard and record the passing result.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `pytest tests/test_config_turnover_validation.py::test_lambda_tc_rejects_non_finite` fails with the finite guard removed and passes after the guard is restored.

## Implementation Notes
Relates to #6023.

```text
## Verification follow-up

Linked implementation: #6023, merged as PR #6042 (`b5f6126b6a4137ed587cad53492525bd2ab26835`; `src/trend_analysis/config/model.py`, `src/trend_analysis/config/models.py`, and `tests/test_config_turnover_validation.py`).

The merged diff adds the finite-value guards and discriminating NaN/+inf/-inf tests. However, the acceptance criterion required removing the finite check, observing `test_lambda_tc_rejects_non_finite` fail, and reverting. PR #6042 records only that the test *would* fail "by test design," not an executed break/revert result.

## Acceptance criterion

- Remove the finite guard in a temporary working tree, run `pytest tests/test_config_turnover_validation.py::test_lambda_tc_rejects_non_finite`, capture the failing result, then restore the guard and record the passing result.

No production behavior change is requested.

Relates to #6023.
```
